app_info.subtitle: Work chats in ChatGPT
app_info.description: Inline helps users find people and conversations, read and search scoped work chats, create threads, upload files, and send messages through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns the current Inline authorization, scopes, and allowed chat context without changing account or workspace state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists spaces available to the scoped Inline grant and does not modify them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change a space.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches known people in allowed Inline contexts and returns matching profile summaries.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact people or write to public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not update profiles, memberships, or conversations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists or resolves conversations visible to the scoped Inline grant.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, archive, or delete conversations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves metadata, participants, and pinned-message identifiers for one allowed Inline conversation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the conversation, its participants, or its messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new thread or chat in an allowed Inline space or home context.
justifications.open_world_justification: The new conversation remains inside the user's bounded Inline workspace rather than publishing to the public internet or a third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new conversation without deleting, overwriting, or revoking existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uploads provided bytes or content fetched from an HTTPS URL into the user's scoped Inline account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads an optional source URL and stores the resulting file in Inline without changing public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new uploaded file and does not delete or overwrite existing content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only extracts file and media metadata from messages in an allowed Inline conversation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not download from or write to public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify messages, files, previews, or conversations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends an uploaded photo, video, or document with an optional caption to an allowed Inline chat or DM.
justifications.open_world_justification: The message is delivered only within Inline rather than to the public internet or a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sends recipient-visible content that cannot be withdrawn through this tool after delivery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends an ordered batch of text and media items to an allowed Inline chat or DM.
justifications.open_world_justification: The batch is delivered only within Inline rather than to the public internet or a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can send multiple recipient-visible messages, including partial batches, that cannot be withdrawn through this tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a filtered page of messages from one allowed Inline chat or DM.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish messages or change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mark, edit, send, or delete messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a bounded message window around an anchor or the latest context in an allowed conversation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish messages or change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mark, edit, send, or delete messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches messages within one allowed Inline conversation and returns matching results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish messages or change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mark, edit, send, or delete messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists unread messages across conversations approved by the Inline grant without marking them read.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish messages or change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mark, edit, send, or delete messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends text to an allowed Inline chat or DM and records the send in the MCP audit log.
justifications.open_world_justification: The message is delivered only within Inline rather than to the public internet or a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sends a recipient-visible message that cannot be withdrawn through this tool after delivery.

test_cases.description: Resolve a conversation by title before reading or sending.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the conversation named Project Atlas and show me the best match.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the best matching allowed conversation with its title, chat identifier, and useful context.

test_cases.description: Review unread work-chat activity within a time range.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me my unread Inline messages from yesterday.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns unread messages from approved conversations within yesterday's time window without marking them read.

test_cases.description: Read recent messages from a resolved conversation.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the latest 20 messages from Inline chat 12345 so I can summarize the discussion.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to 20 recent messages from the allowed chat with structured message details.

test_cases.description: Create a private work thread in an allowed context.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a private Inline thread called Launch Checklist with the selected project participants.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the bounded Inline conversation and returns its chat details for subsequent actions.

test_cases.description: Send a message to a clearly identified Inline conversation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Send 'The launch review starts at 3 PM' to Inline chat 12345.
test_cases.expected_output: Sends the text to the specified allowed conversation and returns the resulting message identifier.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Inline for calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Move my meeting tomorrow from 2 PM to 4 PM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because Inline does not manage calendar events.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Inline for sending email.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email the quarterly report to our accountant.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because Inline tools do not send email.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Inline for open-web research.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for today's technology headlines.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not involve the user's Inline workspace.
